【原视频简介】
In this Minecraft command block tutorial, I built 4 of the most impressive algorithms that turn chaos into satisfying structures and I did it all using ONLY Minecraft command blocks. Starting with a simple two command block sequence to build Sierpiński’s Triangle, and working up to advanced cellular automatons with Cyclic Cellular Simulation, I show how each algorithm works, how to make it, and what you can create with it in Minecraft. If you want to learn Minecraft commands, algorithms, or cool command block creations, this video will show you how INSANE Minecraft commands can really get!
